decision.title: Pagination for books
decision.question: GET /books is page-number paged (page from 1, limit default 10, max 50) and returns meta {page, limit, total}. What should lumen_books_books expose?
decision.context: Recommendation: wrapper. total is the stop signal the caller needs; the same type also serves searchBooks, which returns the same BookPage shape. The genre and ids filters are exposed either way.

choices.label: page and limit arguments; return a page type with data and page/limit/total
page and limit arguments; return the list only (no total)
No paging arguments; return the first page only
